lines.1: 「Oh! It seems you are making quite a spectacle of yourselves. Excellent, excellent.」
lines.4: 「Kurogane, are you providing guidance again today?」
lines.5: 「Yes. I was guiding my juniors as their senior.」
lines.6: 「Indeed! THEN ALL IS WELL! Put them through their paces!」
lines.7: 「Now then, everyone, apply yourselves to your studies today!」
lines.8: Headmaster Tachibana strode away with heavy steps.
lines.10: 「I guess anyone who names a school Ryuumeikan would have pretty old-fashioned taste...」
lines.11: The disciplinary chair turned a level stare on me.
lines.12: Something about meeting her eyes made me tense.
lines.13: 「Leo Tsushima. It has been a long time. I was just thinking of coming to speak with you.」
lines.15: 「It is ironic that our chance to speak came about like this. Still, it seems your parents were right: you have grown somewhat lax.」
lines.16: She was calmly saying all sorts of things. More importantly...
lines.17: 「How do you know my full name?」
lines.21: The disciplinary chair tilted her head in genuine confusion.
lines.23: 「If she's been checking up on us, of course she knows your full name. One look at the roster would even give her your address.」
lines.28: She was staring me down with incredible force now.
lines.29: 「We are in different years, and you appeared to be getting along well with your own friends. I thought it would be presumptuous to interfere.」
lines.31: We were talking straight past each other.
lines.33: 「I have no idea what you're talk--」
